source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Returning Officer's notice of the result, Mid-Ulster Mail 14 Jun 1952 p7 (page image read): no poll in this division, the person entered in column 6 duly elected.

note: Triennial election of the 26 electoral divisions of Magherafelt rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-five members were returned unopposed; the only contest was at Newbridge, where the outgoing Nationalist held the seat. The other twenty-three divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Mid-Ulster Mail, 14 June 1952, p. 7), which lists all 26 divisions (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
